data.one_liner: Add customizable styling indicators directly to default Flutter TabBars
data.what_it_does: Provides customized tab indicators such as DotIndicator, MaterialIndicator, and RectangularIndicator that can be plugged directly into a standard Flutter TabBar.
use_when: You want to enhance the default Flutter TabBar with custom indicator styles like dots or rounded rectangles.
You need customizable padding, radius, and stroke options for tab indicators.
avoid_when: You are implementing completely custom tab bar widgets from scratch rather than using the default TabBar.
You need complex physics or animation engines that go beyond simple indicator painting styles.
strengths: Integrates directly into the default Flutter TabBar.
Provides multiple built-in styles like DotIndicator, MaterialIndicator, and RectangularIndicator.
Highly customizable with radius, padding, and stroke options.
weaknesses: Limited to only 3 different indicator styles.
Not documented beyond the basic styles and usage provided.
data.minimal_example:
TabBar(
  indicatorColor: Colors.green,
  tabs: [
    Tab(text: "Home"),
    Tab(text: "Work"),
  ],
  indicator: DotIndicator(
    color: Colors.black,
    distanceFromCenter: 16,
    radius: 3,
    paintingStyle: PaintingStyle.fill,
  ),
)
